''See also: [[Baldezar Kern Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|Baldezar Kern is the Head of the [[Champion’s Guild]] and a legendary figure known for his immense combat prowess. A [[Soulbound]] warrior, he is famous for singlehandedly destroying the [[South Sea Revolution]]'s armies. His unique power allows him to enter a berserk state where he becomes nearly unstoppable, though using his [[Vessel]] is considered extremely dangerous. Physically, Kern is described as a broad, muscular man with black hair streaked with silver. As a [[Blackwatch Guild Head|Guild Head]], Kern maintains a level of independence and skepticism toward the political maneuvering of other leaders. He has expressed distrust toward those attempting to claim the throne and has refused to commit his [[Champions]] to causes he does not believe in. Despite the decline of his [[Guild]], he remains a figure of significant respect and mythic status. In combat, he utilizes heavy armor and dual maces, demonstrating incredible resilience even when facing powerful opponents like the [[Regent]].}}

== Relationships ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|Baldezar Kern is the father of Torrence. He is an ally or companion to [[Calder]], whom he flanks and waits beside. His connections include [[Estyr]], who punched him through the floor, and [[Tyria]], who uses his name as a comparison for potential death.}}
